items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Bob Haggart and I had done so many things that Bob Crosby got credit for, that we want to get together and organize a group.

ctx.x: It was the Lawson-Haggart band which was another one of my great loves -- and I accomplished so many things with them. Everything was just -- everything turned to honey and cream in that orchestra. I can't ever

remember doing anything wrong with them -- they're not the epitome in drumming, but it was every time we got together, we never had a bad night, and I always looked forward to going out to concerts with them, which I do every year.
